title: Brain Rot is Destroying Indian Youth
description:
Checkout OdinSchool: https://www.0din.link/hdGT6Ddxe

Endless reels. Cringe influencers. Sensational “news.” Our screens are flooded with junk—and we’re addicted to it.

From toxic beauty standards to dumbed-down debates, what we consume daily isn’t just entertainment—it’s shaping how we think, act, and vote. The algorithm rewards outrage, not insight. Fake gurus, viral stupidity, and shallow trends are replacing real learning and curiosity.

In this video, we break down how India's digital culture is slowly rotting our brains—and what we can do to snap out of it.
